Every `legacy_fetch(` call is now `fetch_v2(` with the same arguments, and `legacy_fetch` is gone from `api.py`. That covers the `api.legacy_fetch(...)` calls in `m00`, `m02`, `m04`, `m06`, `m08` and `m10`. It also covers the direct calls in `m01`, `m03`, `m05`, `m07`, `m09` and `m11`, whose `from svc.api import legacy_fetch` lines I changed to import `fetch_v2`.

I imported `svc.m00`, `svc.m01`, `svc.m03` and `svc.m11` and called a few jobs from them. They returned the expected values, for example `body:https://example.test/m03/1:9`. I didn't run any other tests.

One mention of the old name is left on purpose. `m03.py` line 2 is `LOG = "migrating callers off legacy_fetch"`, a plain string rather than a call, so I didn't touch it.
